text:
Maya: Heads-up, planning an RBAC change so Oncall Support can perform customer BYOK imports. Need quick alignment on minimum audit traces and controls before I open the PR. cc @Jordan @Priya
Jordan: We cant give support persistent import perms. Must be approval-gated + dual-op signatures for any import: start/complete.
Priya: Legal will want chain-of-custody proof. Recommend pre-signed import tokens with TTL + explicit rewrap policy.
Samir: From infra: build an import_session short-lived role (ttl=10m) thats only issuable after approval token exchange. Keeps IAM surface tiny.
Maya: What fields do we require in the immutable audit record? timestamps, operator ids, CSR fingerprint, HSM id etc?
Jordan: Minimal audit blob: session_id, initiator, approver(s), action (import:start/import:complete), import_token_id, csr_fp, hsm_serial_or_slot, tenant_id, tooling_version_sha, payload_hash. Use UUIDs for tokens/sessions.
Priya: Add kms_cmk_id (envelope CMK) + envelope_key_id. Retention: many regs require multi-year retention; store under WORM (immutable bucket) for 7+ years and include hash manifests.
Samir: Also store signed evidence JSON (operator sig + approver sig) and push artifact link to #eng-security and ops-bot to create a tamper-evident trail.
ops-bot: import-session created by @Maya - session_id=imp-6754321000-01, approvals_required=1
Maya: Draft RBAC change: create role import_operator with condition requires_approval_token=true. PR coming: https://git.redwood/infra/rr/PR-XXXX. Review pls.
Jordan: Notes for PR: (1) approval must require approver MFA, (2) pre-import check: CMK rotation age <=90d, fail otherwise, (3) log exact CLI/tool binary sha and env.
Priya: IR step: on any unapproved import attempt -> revoke tokens, snapshot HSM audit, preserve evidence blob, notify legal + CS + customer immediately.
Samir: Telemetry: emit metric hsm.import.attempts{outcome=\"success|fail|unauth\"}; alert if >3 failed attempts in 10m for a tenant. Add runbook snippet for oncall.
Maya: Example audit artifact we plan to write (signed JSON):
```
{
  "session_id": "imp-6754321000-01",
  "initiator": "Maya",
  "approver": "Jordan",
  "action": "import:complete",
  "hsm_serial": "HSM-AB12-34",
  "csr_fp": "sha256:abcd...",
  "kms_cmk": "cmk-0a1b2c",
  "payload_hash": "sha256:deadbeef",
  "tooling_sha": "sha1:1234abcd",
  "s3_artifact": "s3://redwood-audit/worm/imp-6754321000-01.json",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-21T14:12:10Z"
}
```
Jordan: Artifact MUST be operator-signed and approver-signed, include cert chain reference.
Priya: I'll own scheduling a short tabletop (support + security + legal + CS) to validate the flow.
Samir: I'll add the prometheus rule + alert and prototype the import_session IAM policy.
Maya: Plan: split into two PRs - (A) RBAC + approval flow, (B) audit pipeline (signing) + telemetry + WORM retention. Filing follow-ups: tabletop invite, link PR to #eng-security, create incident-playbook ticket IR-3421.
Jordan: LGTM.
Priya: Add legal checklist link to PR before merge.
Samir: Will post IAM policy snippet tomorrow.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Action items: Maya -> open PRs, Priya -> tabletop, Samir -> IAM & alerts, Jordan -> review MFA/rotation checks.
